  <style>
:root{--bg:#fafaf9;--fg:#0f172a;--card:#fff;--muted:#f5f5f4;--muted-fg:#64748b;--border:#e9e8e2;--primary:#fb923c;--primary-fg:#fafaf9;--r:10px}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html,body{overflow-x:hidden;width:100%;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;line-height:1.7;color:var(--fg);background:var(--bg)}
img,video,iframe,embed,pre{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration-color:var(--muted-fg);text-underline-offset:3px;overflow-wrap:break-word}
a:hover{text-decoration-color:var(--primary)}
.sh{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px;width:100%}
.cw{padding:16px 0 24px}
.as{max-width:780px;margin:0 auto;width:100%;overflow-wrap:break-word}
.ac{width:100%;overflow:hidden}
.ac img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;border-radius:8px;margin:12px 0}
.ac iframe,.ac video,.ac embed{max-width:100%;border-radius:8px}

/* progress bar */
.progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;background:var(--primary);z-index:100;width:0;transition:width .1s}

/* header */
.hdr{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(250,250,249,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.hdr-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:52px}
.logo{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--fg);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0}
.logo-m{color:#f97316}
.logo-f{color:var(--primary)}
.dnav{display:none}
.dnav a{text-decoration:none;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px;color:var(--fg);font-size:14px}
.dnav a:hover,.dnav a.act{color:var(--primary)}
.dnav a.act{font-weight:600}
.hdr-r{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.btn-cta{text-decoration:none;background:var(--fg);color:var(--primary-fg);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.burger{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--card);cursor:pointer;font-size:20px;color:var(--fg)}
.mob-nav{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99;background:var(--bg)}
.mob-nav.open{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.mob-nav-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.mob-nav-links{flex:1;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;overflow-y:auto}
.mob-nav-links a{text-decoration:none;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;padding:12px 8px;border-radius:8px;color:var(--fg)}
.mob-nav-links a:hover,.mob-nav-links a.act{color:var(--primary);background:rgba(251,146,60,.06)}

/* typography */
h1,h2,h3,h4{line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.01em;overflow-wrap:break-word}
h1{font-size:1.5rem;margin-bottom:10px}
h2{font-size:1.25rem;margin:28px 0 10px}
h3{font-size:1.1rem;margin:22px 0 8px}
p{margin-bottom:16px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.85;overflow-wrap:break-word;word-break:break-word}
.muted{color:var(--muted-fg)}
.meta{color:var(--muted-fg);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.meta-dot{width:3px;height:3px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted-fg);flex-shrink:0}

/* content */
pre{background:#1e293b;color:#e2e8f0;padding:14px;border-radius:8px;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;margin:16px 0}
code{font-size:.85em;background:rgba(15,23,42,.06);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-family:'SF Mono',Monaco,Consolas,monospace}
pre code{background:none;padding:0;font-size:inherit}
blockquote{border-left:3px solid var(--primary);padding:12px 16px;margin:20px 0;color:#475569;background:rgba(251,146,60,.03);border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;font-style:italic;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7}
ul,ol{padding-left:20px;margin:0 0 16px}
li{margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.8;font-size:16px}
.table-wrap{margin:16px 0;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}
.table-scroll{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4}
table,table *{word-break:keep-all !important;overflow-wrap:normal !important;-webkit-hyphens:none !important;hyphens:none !important}
th,td{padding:5px 7px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);text-align:left}
th{background:var(--muted);font-weight:600;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;white-space:nowrap}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.chip{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff3e8;color:#9a3412;text-decoration:none}
.tags{display:none;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px}
.card-date{font-size:12px;margin-bottom:4px;color:var(--muted-fg)}
.card-title{margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.35}
.card-title a{text-decoration:none}
.card-title a:hover{color:var(--primary)}
.card-excerpt{font-size:14px;margin:0;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted-fg);display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}

/* toc */
.toc{background:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px 20px;margin:20px 0}
.toc-title{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px}
.toc ol{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;counter-reset:toc}
.toc li{counter-increment:toc;padding:4px 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4}
.toc li::before{content:counter(toc)".";color:var(--muted-fg);margin-right:6px;font-size:12px}
.toc li a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--fg)}
.toc li a:hover{color:var(--primary)}
.toc .toc-sub{padding-left:16px;font-size:13px}
.toc .toc-sub::before{content:"";margin-right:0}

/* cards & sections */
.hero,.section,.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r)}
.hero{padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px}
.section{padding:14px;margin-bottom:14px}
.acard{padding:16px}
.card{padding:12px}
.cover{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.cover-article{width:100%;aspect-ratio:2/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:var(--r);margin:16px 0}
.g2,.g3,.glib{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}

/* breadcrumb */
.bc{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted-fg);margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.bc a{color:var(--muted-fg);text-decoration:none}
.bc a:hover{color:var(--primary)}

/* share bar */
.share{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:14px 0 18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.share a,.share button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--card);color:var(--muted-fg);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.share a:hover,.share button:hover{border-color:var(--primary);color:var(--primary);background:rgba(251,146,60,.04)}

/* author */
.author-card{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--muted);margin:24px 0}
.author-avatar{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--primary);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--primary-fg);font-weight:700;font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0}
.author-info{font-size:14px}
.author-name{font-weight:700}
.author-role{color:var(--muted-fg);font-size:12px}

/* prev/next */
.pn{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px;margin:24px 0}
.pn-item{padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--card);text-decoration:none;color:var(--fg)}
.pn-item:hover{border-color:var(--primary)}
.pn-label{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted-fg);margin-bottom:4px}
.pn-title{font-weight:600;font-size:14px;line-height:1.3}

/* related */
.related{margin:24px 0}
.related h3{margin-bottom:12px}

/* footer */
.ft{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:28px 0 16px}
.ft-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}
.ft-grid h4{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:14px}
.ft-grid p{margin:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
.ft-note{font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted-fg);padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;margin-top:8px}
.ft-note span{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:11px}
.ft-tg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px 12px}
.ft-tg a,.ft-st a{text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted-fg);padding:2px 0;display:block}
.ft-st{display:grid;gap:4px}
.ft-div{height:1px;background:var(--border);margin:16px 0}
.ft-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.ft-copy p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted-fg)}
.heart{color:#ef4444}
.sl{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:8px}
.sl a{text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted-fg)}

/* comments */
.comments{margin:28px 0}
.comments h3{margin-bottom:16px;font-size:1.15rem}
.cmt{padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--card);margin-bottom:10px}
.cmt-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:13px}
.cmt-name{font-weight:600;color:var(--fg)}
.cmt-time{color:var(--muted-fg);font-size:12px}
.cmt-body{font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word}
.cmt-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:8px}
.like-btn{background:none;border:none;color:var(--muted-fg);font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.like-btn:hover{color:#ef4444}
.like-btn.liked{color:#ef4444}
.reply-btn{background:none;border:none;color:var(--primary);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.reply-btn:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.replies{margin-top:8px;padding-left:20px;border-left:2px solid var(--border)}
.replies .cmt{border:none;padding:10px 0;margin-bottom:0;background:transparent}
.replies .cmt+.cmt{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:10px}
.cmt-avatar{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--primary);color:var(--primary-fg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;flex-shrink:0}
.cf{margin-top:20px;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--card)}
.cf h4{margin-bottom:12px;font-size:1rem}
.cf input,.cf textarea{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);margin-bottom:8px;resize:vertical}
.cf textarea{min-height:80px}
.cf input:focus,.cf textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--primary)}
.cf-row{display:flex;gap:8px}
.cf-row input{flex:1}
.cf-submit{background:var(--fg);color:var(--primary-fg);border:none;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;margin-top:4px}
.cf-submit:hover{opacity:.9}
.cf-submit:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
.cf-note{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted-fg);margin-top:8px}
.cf-msg{padding:10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;margin-top:8px;display:none}
.cf-msg.ok{display:block;background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;border:1px solid #bbf7d0}
.cf-msg.err{display:block;background:#fef2f2;color:#991b1b;border:1px solid #fecaca}
.reply-form{display:none;margin-top:10px}
.reply-form.open{display:block}

@media(min-width:600px){
  .sh{padding:0 20px}.cw{padding:20px 0 32px}h1{font-size:1.75rem}h2{font-size:1.4rem}p{font-size:16px}
  .hero{padding:20px}.section{padding:18px}.acard{padding:22px}.card{padding:14px}
  .g2,.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.glib{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .ft-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px}.ft-copy{flex-direction:row;justify-content:space-between}
  .pn{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .tags{display:flex}
  pre{margin:20px 0;border-radius:8px}
  table{font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}th,td{padding:8px 12px}
  .share a,.share button{padding:8px 16px;font-size:13px}
}
@media(min-width:960px){
  .sh{padding:0 28px}.cw{padding:28px 0 40px}.hdr-inner{min-height:60px}
  .logo{font-size:24px}.dnav{display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center}
  .burger{display:none}
  h1{font-size:2.2rem}h2{font-size:1.7rem}h3{font-size:1.3rem}p{font-size:17px}
  .hero{padding:24px;margin-bottom:18px}.section{padding:20px;margin-bottom:18px}.acard{padding:28px}
  .g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}.g2{gap:16px}.glib{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
  .card{padding:16px}.ft-grid{grid-template-columns:1.2fr 2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:24px}
  table{font-size:14px}th,td{padding:10px 14px}th{font-size:11px}
}
@media(min-width:1200px){.as{max-width:860px}pre{font-size:14px}}

@media(max-width:400px){
  .sh{padding:0 10px}
  .cw{padding:12px 0 20px}
  .acard{padding:14px 12px}
  .section{padding:12px 10px}
  .hero{padding:14px 12px;margin-bottom:10px}
  .card{padding:10px}
  h1{font-size:1.35rem;line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:8px}
  h2{font-size:1.15rem;margin:20px 0 8px}
  h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin:16px 0 6px}
  p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:12px}
  li{font-size:15px;line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:6px}
  .meta{font-size:12px;gap:4px;margin-bottom:10px}
  .bc{font-size:11px;gap:4px;margin-bottom:8px}
  pre{font-size:11px;padding:10px;border-radius:6px;line-height:1.5;margin:12px 0}
  code{font-size:.8em;padding:1px 3px}
  blockquote{padding:8px 12px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;margin:12px 0}
  .toc{padding:10px 12px;margin:12px 0}
  .toc-title{font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}
  .toc li{font-size:12px;padding:3px 0}
  .toc .toc-sub{font-size:11px;padding-left:12px}
  .share{gap:6px;margin:8px 0 12px}
  .share a,.share button{padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;border-radius:16px}
  .cover{aspect-ratio:3/2}
  .cover-article{margin:10px 0;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:8px}
  .author-card{padding:12px;gap:10px;margin:16px 0;flex-direction:row;align-items:flex-start}
  .author-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;font-size:14px}
  .author-info{font-size:12px}
  .author-info p{font-size:12px !important;margin:2px 0 0 !important}
  .pn{gap:8px;margin:16px 0}
  .pn-item{padding:10px}
  .pn-label{font-size:10px}
  .pn-title{font-size:12px}
  .related{margin:16px 0}
  .related h3{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:8px}
  .hdr-inner{min-height:46px}
  .logo{font-size:17px;gap:4px}
  .btn-cta{padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px}
  .burger{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:16px}
  .ft{padding:20px 0 12px}
  .ft-grid{gap:14px}
  .ft-tg{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2px}
  .ft-tg a,.ft-st a{font-size:12px}
  .ft-note{font-size:11px;padding:8px}
  .ft-note span{font-size:10px}
  .ft-copy p{font-size:10px}
  table{font-size:10px;line-height:1.3}
  th,td{padding:4px 5px}
  th{font-size:8px}
  .card-date{font-size:11px}
  .card-title{font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:4px}
  .card-excerpt{font-size:13px;-webkit-line-clamp:2}
}

The last twenty-four hours have seen the emergence of a new paradigm in orchestration logic: the Bayes-consistent control layer.</p><p><strong>The Value of Information (VoI) in Decision Making</strong></p><p>A position paper (arXiv:2605.00742) argues that the orchestration layer—the software that manages how LLMs and tools are queried—must be designed according to Bayesian decision theory. The core premise is that while LLMs excel at prediction, they are often uncalibrated regarding their own "epistemic uncertainty"—the gap between what they know and what they don't. A Bayesian controller maintains a posterior distribution over task-relevant latent variables and only triggers a tool call or an agent action when the "Value of Information" (VoI) outweighs the associated costs and risks.</p><p>This approach treats human feedback not just as a command, but as a probabilistic observation that helps the system refine its internal belief state. This is critical in high-stakes environments, where the cost of a wrong action (e.g., an unauthorized financial transaction) is significantly higher than the cost of asking for clarification.</p><div class="google-auto-placed ap_container" style="width: 100%; This unified data stream is essential for training the next generation of robots that must interact safely and intelligently with the human world.</p><p><strong>Grounding the Visual: DeepSeek’s Visual Primitives and the Reference Gap</strong></p><p>Parallel to hardware sensing breakthroughs, DeepSeek-AI has introduced a revolutionary framework called "Thinking with Visual Primitives" to address the "reference gap" in multimodal large language models (MLLMs).</p><p><strong>Solving the Reference Gap in Multi-Step Reasoning</strong></p><p>Traditional MLLMs often struggle with tasks requiring precise spatial deduction, such as counting objects in a dense scene or navigating a complex layout. DeepSeek’s framework solves this by integrating "visual primitives"—standardized spatial coordinates for points and bounding boxes—directly into the model's reasoning trajectory.</p><div class="google-auto-placed ap_container" style="width: 100%; height: auto; clear: both; text-align: center;"><ins data-ad-format="auto" class="adsbygoogle adsbygoogle-noablate" data-ad-client="ca-pub-4702595988670307" data-adsbygoogle-status="done" style="display: block; margin: auto; background-color: transparent; height: 280px;"><div id="aswift_9_host" style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; height: 280px; width: 802px; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; visibility: visible; background-color: transparent; display: inline-block;"></div></ins></div><p>These primitives are treated as special tokens in the model's vocabulary ($<ref>$ and $<box>$), allowing the model to "point" to objects mid-thought, much like a human circling items on a whiteboard during an explanation. <script>
var BLOG_SLUG='ai-tech-breakthroughs-may-2026-developments',API_BASE='https://devflokers.onrender.com';
function submitComment(){
  var n=document.getElementById('cf-name').value.trim(),e=document.getElementById('cf-email').value.trim(),c=document.getElementById('cf-content').value.trim(),hp=document.getElementById('cf-hp').value,msg=document.getElementById('cf-msg'),btn=document.getElementById('cf-btn');
  if(!n||!e||!c){showMsg(msg,'err','Please fill in all fields.');return;}
  btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Posting...';
  fetch(API_BASE+'/api/blogs/'+BLOG_SLUG+'/comments',{method:'POST',mode:'cors',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({name:n,email:e,content:c,hp:hp})})
  .then(function(r){return r.json()}).then(function(d){
    if(d.success){showMsg(msg,'ok',d.message);document.getElementById('cf-content').value='';} else {showMsg(msg,'err',d.error?.message||'Failed to post.');}
  }).catch(function(){showMsg(msg,'err','Network error.');}).finally(function(){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Post Comment';});
}
function submitReply(parentId,btn){
  var form=document.getElementById('rf-'+parentId);if(!form)return;
  var n=form.querySelector('input[name=name]').value.trim(),e=form.querySelector('input[name=email]').value.trim(),c=form.querySelector('textarea[name=content]').value.trim(),hp=form.querySelector('input[name=hp]').value;
  if(!n||!e||!c){alert('Please fill in all fields.');return;}
  btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Posting...';
  fetch(API_BASE+'/api/blogs/'+BLOG_SLUG+'/comments',{method:'POST',mode:'cors',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({name:n,email:e,content:c,parentId:parentId,hp:hp})})
  .then(function(r){return r.json()}).then(function(d){
    if(d.success){alert(d.message);form.querySelector('textarea[name=content]').value='';form.classList.remove('open');} else {alert(d.error?.message||'Failed.');}
  }).catch(function(){alert('Network error.');}).finally(function(){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Post Reply';});
}
function openReply(id){var f=document.getElementById('rf-'+id);if(f)f.classList.toggle('open');}
function likeComment(id){
  var btn=document.getElementById('lb-'+id),cnt=document.getElementById('lc-'+id);
  if(!btn||btn.disabled)return;btn.disabled=true;
  fetch(API_BASE+'/api/blogs/'+BLOG_SLUG+'/comments/'+id+'/like',{method:'POST',mode:'cors'})
  .then(function(r){return r.json()}).then(function(d){
    if(d.success){cnt.textContent=d.data.likes;btn.innerHTML='♥ '+d.data.likes;btn.classList.add('liked');}
    else{alert(d.error?.message||'Could not like.');}
  }).catch(function(){alert('Network error.');}).finally(function(){btn.disabled=false;});
}
function showMsg(el,type,text){el.className='cf-msg '+type;el.textContent=text;el.style.display='block';}
</script>
